result.summary: Found 2 issues: a confusing promotional badge and an inconsistent favorite icon style.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card displays a '-100%' badge, which is mathematically confusing and inconsistent with the '€0 delivery' badge used elsewhere in the app.
issues.suggestion: Replace the '-100%' badge with clearer text such as '€0 delivery', 'Free delivery', or the actual discount percentage (e.g., '-20%').

issues.description: The favorite heart icons use different treatments in the 'Popular right now' cards: the ramen card has a white outline heart while the pizza card has a heart inside a dark circular button, creating a visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite icon style across all restaurant cards, ensuring adequate contrast against varying background images.
